source: Routes: ddot-routes-3d.json + smart-routes-3d.json (estate GTFS-derived). Water: assets/detroit-water.json (OpenStreetMap natural=water via Overpass 2026-10-17; US Census TIGER/Line 2025 areawater). Streets: assets/detroit-streets.json (US Census TIGER/Line 2025 roads, Wayne/Oakland/Macomb). Street labels: assets/detroit-street-names.json.
projection: Scene metres inverted with the files' own documented origin lat0=42.381161 lon0=-83.148531: lat = lat0 - y/111320; lon = lon0 + x/(111320*cos(lat0)). Verified exactly against detroit-streets.json meta.bbox (x: -19445..20500, y: -11000..22616 reproduced to <1 m).
distilled: 2026-11-08: Douglas-Peucker simplify (routes 25 m, water 50 m), coordinates rounded to 5 dp.
